description:
Create/replace a topic's executive summary. One per topic; replacing archives the old (restorable).

WARNING: a bad summary poisons every future session. Do NOT consolidate from partial knowledge.
BEFORE calling: (1) memory_deep_search the topic; (2) read 20+ memories, not previews; (3) if a summary exists, retrieve and EXTEND it; (4) reflect the whole corpus, not just this conversation.
Cover: what the topic is + why, current state + key decisions, solved + open questions.
Restore an archived one: search type_filter="summary_archived", retrieve, re-consolidate.
Fails if <10 memories or too thin.

collection.description: Shared collection by name. Omit = your personal namespace. The 10-memory floor counts THAT namespace, so a topic living in a collection must name it here or the count sees only your personal rows.

content.description: The summary. Present tense, self-contained: what it is, state, decisions, open questions.

name: memory_consolidate
